== Notes ==
* Death from this skill will not cause the user to incur [[Death Penalty]] nor impede their [[Survivor]] title track progress.
* [[PvE]] foes that die from this skill do not yield [[Experience]] or [[Loot]], unless they are resurrected and killed again normally.

== Trivia ==

*  The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Death Pact Signet/Skill history|PvE]] and [[Death Pact Signet (PvP)/Skill history|PvP]] skill histories for details.
